# GamedevJelly

> 1,660 hand-filtered guides, videos and posts plus 45 repos, 52 assets and 31 books. Outdated and obsolete links were removed; the focus is current Unity.

Use this when building something in Unity (shaders, VFX, gameplay systems, tools, performance) and you want vetted references: find the best guides, repos, assets and books first, then read the most relevant ones before writing code.

## How to search
- Load [library.json](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/library.json): one array, newest first. Each item has title, url, description, topics (slugs), creator, format (video/article/post), published, `built_with` (tools: shadergraph, hlsl, vfxgraph, compute, dots, uitoolkit), `unity_era` (6 = published for Unity 6, 2022, 2021, old; estimated from the date unless the link states a version, in which case `unity` is set) and, where stated, `pipeline` (urp, hdrp, builtin).
- Filter by `topics` using the slugs in [topics.json](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/topics.json), then match keywords in title and description.
- Prefer items with `unity_era: 6` and a recent `published` date; check the render pipeline (`urp`/`hdrp`) matches the project.
- [repos.json](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/repos.json), [assets.json](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/assets.json) and [books.json](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/books.json) list tools and reading; repos include install instructions and a `unity7` status where known.

## Data
- [Library (all guides)](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/library.json): 1,660 items
- [Topics](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/topics.json): slugs, names, groups, counts
- [Creators](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/creators.json): who made the guides, with links
- [Repos](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/repos.json), [Assets](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/assets.json), [Books](https://gamedevjelly.com/data/books.json)
- [Everything in one text file](https://gamedevjelly.com/llms-full.txt)
